reason: Most of what my guys send is a handwritten nota from the material shop, faded and half in shorthand, and I don't believe a bot reads those right. If I still have to check every row against the photo, I can wire up n8n and ChatGPT to a sheet myself over a weekend and not pay monthly for it.
objection: It will misread the handwritten Indonesian nota, wrong amounts or the supplier name mangled, and I will spend my evenings fixing rows. Then it is not 'nobody types', it is me typing corrections.
would_change_my_mind: Running my own pile of real handwritten nota through the free 30 and seeing almost all of them come out right with no fixing. If it handles those better than what I could hack together, $19 is fine.
